scope: Native gcodes directory move software increment using the existing process file store, print identity and current device delegate. Not complete M2b/Moonraker, real-client acceptance, target performance, Python retirement or G3 approval.

implementation.namespace: Existing gcodes visible namespace over immutable content blobs and receipt IDs; no second file store or print state machine.

intent.name: .namespace-move.json
intent.decision: Fsynced staged intent renamed into private directory then root synced before any receipt rewrite. Once published, cancellation finishes the decision; failures fence new reads/mutations until reopen.
intent.recovery: Validate exact schema/deterministic transformation, complete current old/new receipt membership, directories and every content reference before rewriting or cleaning anything; idempotent roll-forward across partial receipts/catalog, including interrupted startup replay.
intent.quota: Reserve complete journal, maximum staged receipt, full staged directory catalog and all positive receipt growth; release only operation reservation. Recovery may still fail on unavailable storage and preserves intent.

implementation.catalog: During exclusive directory preparation/commit, cached lists serve a coherent last durable namespace; all indexes switch after durable authorities complete. Descriptor reads and mutations retain queue barriers.
implementation.authorization: Authorize raw source/dest, resolved directory target and every child source/dest with immutable ID/hash/size. Recheck approved membership and live receipt/directory authorities before intent. Yield between policy groups.
implementation.activeFiles: PrintController atomically holds every affected ID, with bounded 64 mutation admissions and up to existing 10000 file IDs; any active/paused/unacknowledged-stop identity rejects the entire directory operation. Empty directories still acquire maintenance activity.
implementation.notifications: One durable move_dir per operation with source_item; no fake child create/delete/move_file. Transport authorization remains in existing observer owner.
implementation.metadata: Invalidate old/new child paths after commit; metadata/downloads validate current receipt; old path/previews revoke, sealed readers retain original bytes.
implementation.lifecycle: Reuse process-level server.files.move route and current generation mutation delegation. Existing retirement/drain/late-request protection remains.

compiled.isolation: Explicit staged source checkout-index snapshot; production package independently installs locked dependencies, with PATH=/no-programs, NODE_PATH empty, no Python, no TS loader, no shared production node_modules. PTY firmware remains a simulation.
compiled.budgets: Original positive minimum step lead and event-loop P99<50 ms/max<100 ms retained; no motion tolerances, deadlines or watchdog relaxation.

metrics.scope: Workspace filesystem durable directory operations and alternating cached catalog baseline; original 50 ms catalog P95 and 50/100 ms loop budgets retained. 10,000-file planner is a capacity experiment, not an actual 10,000-file transaction or target-board/print-duration acceptance.

benchmark.limits: 128-file durable moves and 1024-file cached catalog on workspace ext filesystem. 10000-file planning measured; full 10000-file durable transaction, target storage/CPU and old/new real print duration remain unverified.

initialFailures.cause: New HTTP fixtures used default identical part.gcode filenames; corrected explicit distinct filenames. Existing collision and identity behavior retained.
